context_differences: Actual: 60 synthetic players, six batches/coaches and no trial enrolments. The selected player is Aadi Fictional U8, with recorded Dribbling focus and August/September history.
Individual birth dates, positions and portraits were not supplied. The interface uses missing-value labels and avatar fallbacks rather than assigning invented values.
visual_differences: The directory, four summary cards and selected-player panel retain the reference arrangement. The toolbar includes a local player search and omits the reference More Filters button.
Actual table rows and the selected-player content are taller; ten rows plus the added Trial enrolment section make the full page 1304 px high versus 1024 px.
The large portrait, row photos and selected-player star in the reference are replaced by honest empty-avatar treatment. Support type and table labels are smaller than the reference.
limitations: The added real Trial enrolment controls are part of the later functional scope. Missing portraits and player attributes limit a like-for-like visual comparison.
